claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_illusion_awareness
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: When a creature passes the Investigation check against a silent image (or any illusion), it 'can see through the image.' This is a persistent per-creature state change — the creature's relationship to the illusion is updated — that has no EffectAtom. { kind: 'none' } was used as a placeholder for onPass in the ability_check_gate, leaving the disbelief outcome unmodeled. The create_illusion atom comment explicitly defers this to 'separate surfaces'; that separate surface needs an atom.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image.
